scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
